standard.label: Standard Pakistani Urdu (default)
standard.description: Educated urban Pakistani Urdu, careful citation pronunciation. Perso-Arabic /q x ɣ f z ʒ/ are expected; ع and ح are not realised as pharyngeals.

punjabi.label: Punjabi-influenced Urdu
punjabi.description: Tendencies reported for Punjabi-L1 speakers. They are scored as legitimate variants, not errors. Validate against your own speaker data.

pashto.label: Pashto-influenced Urdu
pashto.description: Tendencies reported for Pashto-L1 speakers (Pashto has no phonemic aspiration). Scored as legitimate variants. Validate against your own speaker data.
